loss_choice: predeclared before acquisition results; not tuned with evaluation labels
candidate_information: Verified-normal training IDs, frozen patch features and mean-normalized-patch global descriptors; same pool for every policy. Unselected patches never enter the detector memory.
oracle_information: Query masks/labels only for offline counterfactual losses; never for deployed policies or training targets.
no_acquisition_baseline: initial k=1 memory; pool scans excluded from detector memory; not a strict-k-shot claim for acquisition policies
budget_unit: per query inspection; reset to the same initial S for each query; no cumulative bank across queries
